title: Echo and Protocol
author: Xanthe Eriksen
blurb: Gideon Okafor, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
